flows.name: Understand and preview prefill
steps: Inspect included and excluded source records
Reset and correct the selected options
flows.expectedOutcome: The SOV, retainage, attachments, and source lineage respond deterministically to the selected creation-time options

checks: Primary action is visible and usable
Option dependency and error states are legible
No nested cards, stat cards, or duplicate primary actions

claims.description: The non-persisting starting state is captured
Retainage cannot remain enabled when cost prefill is off
Included and excluded source records and reasons are inspectable
The non-persisted draft preview result is captured
Desktop, tablet, and mobile visual review is complete
Deterministic eligibility and option behavior has focused coverage
